LanguageData.XMT_StructureCommandsDesc: Create structures unlocked by the queen's advancements.
LanguageData.XMT_StructureLocked: The queen has not unlocked this structure.
LanguageData.XMT_StructureSiteOccupied: Another hive transformation already reserves this footprint.
LanguageData.XMT_StructureSourceInvalid: This structure is not sufficiently grown or otherwise eligible.
LanguageData.XMT_StructureSacrificeWarning: This creates a living structure by transforming a cryptimorph. The selected pawn will cease acting independently and be preserved inside the structure. Continue to select a contributor?
LanguageData.XMT_StructureSacrificeConfirm: Transform {0} into {1}? This sacrifices their independent pawn form and preserves them inside the structure.
LanguageData.XMT_JellyWellFirstWarning: Creating a jelly well merges a cryptimorph with a larder of body size 4 or greater. Both contributors are preserved. Continue to choose the larder?
LanguageData.XMT_GroupInputsDesc: The filter initially shows the first selected entity's settings. Editing or pasting replaces the filters of every selected entity. Only materials valid for all selected entities are available.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidDigesting: Processing {0}. Estimated time remaining: {1} with jelly supplied.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidProcessingNeedsJelly: Additional jelly required to finish processing.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidRetainedResidue: Retained material: {0} resin. Waiting for more material to produce a whole unit.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidUnavailable: pit is reserved, forbidden, or unreachable
LanguageData.XMT_AcidNoMaterial: no available, reachable material allowed by this pit's filter
LanguageData.XMT_AcidProcessingDesc: Allow hauling jobs to insert material accepted by this pit's input filter. An inserted object finishes digesting even when acceptance is disabled.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidSplashDesc: Spray a cone of acid {0} tiles toward the selected cell. Each pawn caught takes {1} acid damage, including allies unless acid-immune. Empty affected cells receive acid blood. Blocking edifices stop the spray. Consumes {2} of the maximum acid reserve.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidNotReady: Insufficient acid or the pit is recovering from its last splash.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidHarvestNotFull: the acid reserve must be full
LanguageData.XMT_AcidCannotExtract: pawn cannot extract here, or the pit is unavailable
LanguageData.XMT_AcidAllowExtractionDesc: Allow doctors to extract {0} acid from this pit when it is full and not processing material. Extraction drains its entire acid reserve.
LanguageData.XMT_AcidHealing: Healing with jelly. Acid production is paused until fully healed.
LanguageData.XMT_SteamBoilerDesc: Divert useful heater output into steam. Conversion is inefficient; diverted energy does not also heat the room.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Childcare: Positions ovomorphs and applies ovomorphing to suitable hosts.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Doctor: Feeds hive dependents and supplies eligible mechanoids with metabolic energy.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Warden: Feeds or cocoons prisoners and supplies eligible mechanoids with metabolic energy.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Cooking: Converts allowed material into jelly. Individual makers have configurable input filters; empty terrain remains eligible.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Hunting: Hunts prey and responds to marked enemies.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Construction: Hive construction consumes food to secrete resin instead of using raw materials. Also tends overheated nest structures.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Growing: Performs unlocked mutation and host-transformation tasks. Sacrifice and merge commands always require explicit player orders.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Art: Creates corpse sculptures and resin art.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Crafting: Lets cryptimorph mechanitors fill accessible mechanoid material reserves.
LanguageData.XMT_WorkDescription_Hauling: Moves ovomorphs into storage, feeds ovothrone queens, and supplies acid pits with selected inorganic material.
LanguageData.XMT_JellyFilterPasted: Jelly production filter pasted. Only valid materials were applied.
LanguageData.XMT_ResinFilterPasted: Resin conversion filter pasted. Only valid materials were applied.
